open_points.subject: _revoke_viewer_sessions and revoke_viewer_access
open_points.text: MUST return every session newly revoked for viewer_id with the supplied revoked_at and leave already revoked sessions unchanged.
open_points.other_text: The addressed credential becomes a replacement carrying revoked_at and revoked_by, and every session of that viewer a replacement carrying revoked_at (ViewerSession has no revoked_by), so revoking a credential also ends the sessions it authorised.
open_points.question: Must already revoked sessions remain unchanged, or must every session—including an already revoked session—be replaced?
